datasetScope: Estimated total nutrition for the entire photographed meal in each of the 67 JPG images in the Supabase 265 bucket.

methodology.analysisType: One-time visual food identification and reference-based portion/nutrition estimation; no runtime image analysis.
methodology.servingDefinition: The complete meal or multi-person spread visible in the photograph, not a per-100-g value.
methodology.nutritionReference: USDA FoodData Central generic prepared-food and ingredient profiles, combined by estimated visible mass. Restaurant composite references are used when ingredients or cooking fat are obscured.
methodology.uncertaintyPolicy: Every field receives a best estimate. confidence, estimationBasis, and notes disclose ambiguity instead of using null values.
methodology.rounding: Calories rounded to about 10 kcal; macronutrients mostly to 1 g; minerals mostly to 10 mg; iron to 0.1 mg.

sourceReferences.name: USDA FoodData Central
sourceReferences.use: Generic ingredient and prepared-food nutrient profiles used for component-based estimates.

sourceReferences.name: FDA Daily Value reference guide
sourceReferences.use: Daily Value constants recorded for future derived %DV calculations; no %DV values are stored in meal records.

dailyValueReferences.note: Total sugar intentionally has no project %DV because the FDA Daily Value is for added sugar, not total sugar.
